title: Pure Mist Blueberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Blueberry perfectly captures the rich, juicy, and sumptuously sweet flavour of freshly picked Blueberries, delivering a tangy and refreshing vape. This smooth and satisfying e-liquid is ideal for vapers who enjoy familiar yet deeply flavourful fruity blends. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers a variety of VG/PG ratios to cater to different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Blackjack provides a flavour-packed option for adult vapers. Made in the UK with premium ingredients, this e-liquid delivers consistent quality and satisfaction.
